name.ja: 30MP 綾波レイ(プラグスーツVer.)

description.ja: 30 MINUTES LABEL 「30 MINUTES PREFERENCE」より『ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版』に登場の綾波レイをプラグスーツ姿で豊富な付属パーツとともに商品化！
description.en: 30 MINUTES LABEL From "30 MINUTES PREFERENCE ", Rei Ayanami, who appeared in " Evangelion: Rebuild of Evangelion", is commercialized in a plug suit with a variety of accessory parts!

description.ja: ■タンポ印刷を施した2種類のフェイスパーツが付属。
description.en: • Two types of face parts with tampo printing are included.

description.ja: ■印刷無しのフェイスパーツと、多数の表情を選択できる水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with unprinted face parts and water transfer decals that allow you to choose from a variety of facial expressions.

description.ja: ■体育座り用の交換パーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with replacement parts for PE sitting.

description.ja: ■プラグスーツは艶のある質感で表現。
description.en: • The plug suit has a glossy texture.

description.ja: ■ロンギヌスの槍、S-DAT、ゲンドウの眼鏡が付属。
description.en: • Includes Spear of Longinus, S-DAT, and Gendo's glasses.

accessories.ja: フェイスパーツ(タンポ印刷済)×2種
フェイスパーツ(印刷無し)×1式
体育座り用交換パーツ×1式
accessories.en: Replacement parts for physical education sitting x 1 set
